title: The Haunting of Hollybrook
subtitle: Ghost Stormers — 13 Omens Preview
source: 13 Omens Preview (2026), character sheets pp. 35–43 (PDF pp. 37–45)

the_face.name: The Face
the_face.goal: Stop at nothing, including endangering yourself and the crew, to beat out 'Ghost Bros'.

perks.name: Bossy
perks.desc: Once per Act, demand another aid you (Edge), taking highest and lowest die.

perks.name: Demand Focus
perks.desc: Charm check to draw attention gains an Edge.

perks.name: Face Danger
perks.desc: Once per scene when recorded, cancel 1 Flaw from supernatural danger.

perks.name: Nonbeliever
perks.desc: Ignore 1 Flaw vs supernatural if refusing to acknowledge reality.

perks.name: Self-Confident
perks.desc: Once per Act, give a 1-min pep talk to add an Edge to 1 check in next min.

perks.name: Wealthy
perks.desc: Start with 8 gear items and $500 in cash.

gopher_supreme.name: Gopher Supreme
gopher_supreme.goal: Sneak away to work on your screenplay (your ticket out of this job).
gopher_supreme.traits: Burnt Out, Fed Up, Grumbly, Helpful, Passive Aggressive, Tired

perks.name: Carry On
perks.desc: Never take a Flaw on any Check when at 3 Wounds.

perks.name: Five Minute Break
perks.desc: Once per story, 5-min uninterrupted break removes a Strain.

perks.name: Gripe and Complain
perks.desc: Once per Act, on a Flaw roll take highest and lowest dice.

perks.name: Pack Mule
perks.desc: Start with 6 gear items. Pull 1 forgot item once per story.

perks.name: Perfect Tool
perks.desc: Once per story, produce the perfect tool for Edge and keep it.

perks.name: Quick Search
perks.desc: Search twice as fast or twice as large without Flaws.

the_fan.name: The Fan
the_fan.goal: Get every member of Ghost Stormers to sign your notebook and nab souvenirs.
the_fan.traits: Eager, Excitable, Friendly, Knowledgeable, Overfamiliar, Talkative

perks.name: Eager to Help
perks.desc: Once per Act when aiding, cancel 1 additional Flaw on that roll.

perks.name: Encyclopedic Memory
perks.desc: Once per Act, add an Edge to Ghost Stormers Lore Check.

perks.name: Got to Impress
perks.desc: Once per Act, if observed by 2+ crew members, add an Edge.

perks.name: In Episode 17...
perks.desc: Once per Act, give another character 1 handheld gear piece.

perks.name: Local Edge
perks.desc: Once per Act, cancel a Flaw on Evade or Perception.

perks.name: Lucky
perks.desc: Once per game, use Luck in place of any Aspect.

tech_specialist.name: Tech Specialist
tech_specialist.goal: Refine demo reel to send to a Hollywood studio; hunt for evocative shots.
tech_specialist.traits: Chill, Dedicated, Drama Averse, Focused, Professional, Understated

perks.name: Chill Out
perks.desc: Ignore first Flaw on Courage Check. Lost if Courage is Strained.

perks.name: Close Up
perks.desc: Edge on Perception while filming or reviewing footage.

perks.name: Junk Bag
perks.desc: Start with 6 gear items. Select 1 forgot item once per story.

perks.name: Shot Focused
perks.desc: Edge on checks made in response to what is seen through lens.

perks.name: Tech Pro
perks.desc: Once per Act, add an Edge to Technology Check.

perks.name: Tinkerer
perks.desc: Use Technology to make gear perform unintended functions.

true_believer.name: The True Believer
true_believer.goal: Expose 'The Truth' by getting the crew to film undeniable paranormal evidence.
true_believer.traits: Awkward, Convinced, Gullible, Mysterious, Obsessed, Zealous

perks.name: Awkward Pause
perks.desc: Once per story, reroll any check with same dice, take better result.

perks.name: Believer
perks.desc: Ignore 1 Flaw vs supernatural if believing it is real.

perks.name: Insight into the Occult
perks.desc: Edge when checking to understand supernatural effects.

perks.name: Invisible
perks.desc: Once per Act, pass off a requested check to another in scene.

perks.name: Strange Ritual
perks.desc: Once per Act, perform ritual to grant another an Edge for 1 min.

perks.name: The Truth
perks.desc: Take Omen Wound only on rolling a 1 (any Act), but die at 2 Wounds and never Cheat Death.
